contracts.approximation: 512900 is the original integer-angle arcsine approximation. For finite x in[-1,1], it computes float32 sqrt(1-x*x) with original x87 operation ordering and a float store before/after5c0240, then takes the minimum of that root and abs(x). Two independently clamped scaled values encode sign and the abs(x)≈0.70710677 branch. The odd polynomial includes terms through power9. Exact PC constants, ordered64-significand multiplication/addition and the intermediate float32 stores are retained; final scaling by10430.400390625 is truncated to the full native EAX integer.
